audit_comment: OA round seven (capture pp. 28-31): the kensai - the dual prime requisites, the natural AC formula and step, the initiative and ki powers, the damage and to-hit ladders, the pupil and whirlwind powers, the restrictions and practice, and the duel doctrine with the honor demotion.

consts.name: dggKensaiMinStr
consts.comment: Kensai prose (capture p. 29): the Strength minimum

consts.name: dggKensaiMinWis
consts.comment: Kensai prose (capture p. 29): the Wisdom minimum

consts.name: dggKensaiMinDex
consts.comment: Kensai prose (capture p. 29): the Dexterity minimum

consts.name: dggKensaiHitDie
consts.comment: Kensai prose (capture p. 29): the 10-sided hit die, one per level

consts.name: dggKensaiSlots
consts.comment: Kensai prose (capture p. 29): three initial proficiency slots - the free chosen-weapon proficiency costs none; only one slot may buy a second weapon; the rest must be peaceful skills

consts.name: dggKensaiNaturalAcBase
consts.comment: Kensai prose (capture p. 29): the natural AC formula - 23 minus Dexterity (the printed Dex 16 to AC 7 example)

consts.name: dggKensaiAcStepLevels
consts.comment: Kensai prose (capture p. 29): the natural AC improves one step per three levels

consts.name: dggKensaiInitBase
consts.comment: Kensai prose (capture p. 29): +1 on all initiative rolls, melee and missile, self only in a group

consts.name: dggKensaiSaveBonus
consts.comment: Kensai prose (capture p. 29): +1 on all saving throws

consts.name: dggKensaiDuelBonusVsOthers
consts.comment: Kensai prose (capture p. 29): the psychic-duel bonus vs. non-kensai; vs. another kensai only the levels count

consts.name: dggKensaiDmgLevels
consts.comment: Kensai prose (capture p. 30): the damage bonus steps - +1 at 2nd, again at 5th, 8th, 10th and 12th, total +5

consts.name: dggKensaiHitLevels
consts.comment: Kensai prose (capture p. 30): the to-hit bonus steps - +1 at 3rd, again at 5th, 8th, 10th and 12th, total +5 and the equivalence of a magical +5 weapon

consts.name: dggKensaiInitTwo
consts.comment: Kensai prose (capture p. 30): the initiative bonus rises to +2 at 5th (the printed total modifier)

consts.name: dggKensaiInitThree
consts.comment: Kensai prose (capture p. 30): the initiative bonus rises to +3 at 9th

consts.name: dggKensaiMeditateLevel
consts.comment: Kensai prose (capture p. 30): at 4th level meditates like a shukenja

consts.name: dggKensaiSurpriseLevel
consts.comment: Kensai prose (capture p. 30): at 6th level surprised only on a 1 on 1d6

consts.name: dggKensaiTwoWeaponsLevel
consts.comment: Kensai prose (capture p. 30): at 7th level two weapons simultaneously with no penalty, and causes fear as a samurai

consts.name: dggKensaiPupilDie
consts.comment: Kensai prose (capture p. 30): at 9th level attracts 1d6 pupils, all 1st-level kensai specializing in the master weapon

consts.name: dggKensaiPupilDepartPct
consts.comment: Kensai prose (capture p. 30): a 5 percent chance per level that a pupil ends studies and leaves

consts.name: dggKensaiPupilLossPct
consts.comment: Kensai prose (capture p. 30): a 50 percent chance per pupil of leaving when the master loses a duel to a lower-level kensai

consts.name: dggKensaiWhirlwindLevel
consts.comment: Kensai prose (capture p. 30): the whirlwind attack at 11th level

consts.name: dggKensaiWhirlwindRange
consts.comment: Kensai prose (capture p. 30): the whirlwind attacks all opponents within 10 feet once in the same round

consts.name: dggKensaiDuelXpMultiplier
consts.comment: Kensai prose (capture p. 31): double experience for defeating another kensai in a duel; a duel with a particular opponent once per level

consts.name: dggKensaiPracticeHours
consts.comment: Kensai prose (capture p. 31): at least two hours of daily practice; every skipped two-hour session must be made up before advancing (four hours per day when catching up - the printed Kiyomori example)

consts.name: dggT18RowCount
consts.comment: Table 18 (capture pp. 28-29): twelve rows, levels 1-12

consts.name: dggT18XpBeyond
consts.comment: Table 18 note (capture p. 29): 250,000 experience points per level beyond 12th

consts.name: dggT18HpBeyond
consts.comment: Table 18 note (capture p. 29): 2 hit points per level beyond 9th

consts.name: dggT19RowCount
consts.comment: Table 19 (capture p. 30): twelve rows, levels 1 through 12+

consts.name: dggT19SpecNone
consts.comment: Table 19 special code (capture p. 30): none

consts.name: dggT19SpecMeditate
consts.comment: Table 19 special code (capture p. 30): meditation at 4th

consts.name: dggT19SpecSurprise
consts.comment: Table 19 special code (capture p. 30): the 1-in-6 surprise at 6th

consts.name: dggT19SpecTwoWeapons
consts.comment: Table 19 special code (capture p. 30): two weapons and fear at 7th

consts.name: dggT19SpecPupils
consts.comment: Table 19 special code (capture p. 30): the 1-6 pupils at 9th

consts.name: dggT19SpecWhirlwind
consts.comment: Table 19 special code (capture p. 30): the whirlwind attack at 11th

bools.name: dggKensaiDualPrime
bools.comment: Kensai prose (capture p. 29): Wisdom and Dexterity are the prime requisites - both 14 or higher earns the 10 percent experience bonus

bools.name: dggKensaiLawfulOnly
bools.comment: Kensai prose (capture p. 29): must be lawful - good, evil or neutral; humans, hengeyokai and spirit folk only

bools.name: dggKensaiFighterTables
bools.comment: Kensai prose (capture p. 29): the fighter combat and saving throw tables; any weapon, no armor

bools.name: dggKensaiNinjaHonorUnless
bools.comment: Kensai prose (capture p. 29): ninja preferred weapons lose honor - unless it is the chosen weapon

bools.name: dggKensaiNoDexAdjustments
bools.comment: Kensai prose (capture p. 29): no Reaction/Attack or Defensive Adjustments from Dexterity - the natural AC replaces them

bools.name: dggKensaiKiMaxDamage
bools.comment: Kensai prose (capture p. 29): the ki power - maximum damage on one attack with the specialty weapon, announced before the to-hit roll, times per day equal to level

bools.name: dggKensaiImmuneFear
bools.comment: Kensai prose (capture p. 29): all kensai are immune to fear

bools.name: dggKensaiPupilGain
bools.comment: Kensai prose (capture p. 30): defeating a higher-level kensai in a duel gains 1-2 additional pupils

bools.name: dggKensaiWhirlwindCostsAllKi
bools.comment: Kensai prose (capture p. 30): the whirlwind requires the entire day ki (none used before), specialty weapon only, initiative applies, no max-damage guarantee, all other bonuses apply

bools.name: dggKensaiNoMagicSpecialty
bools.comment: Kensai prose (capture p. 30): never a magical weapon of the specialty type - no true measure of skill; all armor prohibited

bools.name: dggKensaiHalfXpOtherWeapon
bools.comment: Kensai prose (capture p. 30): one-half experience for opponents defeated with a non-specialty weapon - even in part, unless fighting with specialty and another weapon at once

bools.name: dggKensaiDuelChallenge
bools.comment: Kensai prose (capture p. 31): on each level gain a 10-times-new-level percent chance of a duel challenge from a same-level kensai

bools.name: dggKensaiDuelRefuseCost
bools.comment: Kensai prose (capture p. 31): refusing or losing the duel forfeits the new level (bottom of the old) and loses honor; the 10th level must be dueled for; NPC duels cost honor only, never a level

bools.name: dggKensaiDuelConditions
bools.comment: Kensai prose (capture p. 31): the duel need not be to the death - surrender, first blood, first strike or first draw; no magical weapons or armor; no aid or support

bools.name: dggKensaiHonorDemotion
bools.comment: Kensai prose (capture p. 31): honor below the family honor means demotion to bushi of the same level - abilities kept, no new kensai abilities, bushi advancement

bools.name: dggKensaiBirthRequired
bools.comment: Kensai prose (capture p. 31): not high birth by requirement but must roll Table 38 - treated socially by birth until the reputation forms

tables.name: dggT18Grid
tables.comment: the Table 18 kensai advancement grid (capture pp. 28-29)
col_comments: the experience column: the upper xp bound of each level, 3,000 at 1st to 1,250,000 at 12th (capture pp. 28-29).
the accumulated d10 dice column: one per level through 9th, then held at 9 (capture pp. 28-29).
the hit-point bonus column: the printed 9-plus-N cells - 2 per level beyond 9th: 0 through 9th, then 2, 4, 6 (capture pp. 28-29).
tables.audit_comment: the Table 18 grid: the level xp bounds and the accumulated dice plus bonus (capture pp. 28-29)

tables.name: dggT19Grid
tables.comment: the Table 19 kensai bonuses grid (capture p. 30)
col_comments: the initiative bonus column: +1 at 1st, +2 from 5th, +3 from 9th (capture p. 30).
the AC bonus column: +1 at 3rd stepping to +4 at 10th (capture p. 30).
the damage bonus column: +1 at 2nd stepping to +5 at 12+ (capture p. 30).
the to-hit bonus column: +1 at 3rd stepping to +5 at 12+ (capture p. 30).
the special code column: none 0, meditation 1 at 4th, the 1-in-6 surprise 2 at 6th, two weapons and fear 3 at 7th, the 1-6 pupils 4 at 9th, the whirlwind 5 at 11th (capture p. 30).
tables.audit_comment: the Table 19 grid: the initiative, AC, damage and to-hit ladders with the special power codes across levels 1-12+ (capture p. 30)

table_checks.note: the T18 level-10 row - nine dice plus the 2 bonus (capture p. 29)
the whirlwind special sits at level 11 (capture p. 30)
the kensai and bushi beyond-9th hp steps agree (capture pp. 27, 29)
